content.title: Abroad jaana hai?
content.subtitle: Jaldi shuru karoge, toh last minute ki tension nahi hogi.

steps.title: Shortlist banao
steps.detail: Dream, target aur safe, teeno type ki universities. Sirf ranking nahi, course aur budget bhi dekho.
steps.tip: Apne jaise real profiles Admit Finder pe dekho.

steps.title: Test date book karo
steps.detail: IELTS, TOEFL, PTE ya GRE, jo bhi chahiye. Date pehle lo aur ek retake ka time bhi rakho.
steps.tip: IELTS kit ke free mock se pehle apna level check karo.

steps.title: SOP ka pehla draft
steps.detail: Apni kahani likho, resume mat dohrao. Pehla draft rough hoga, chalega.
steps.tip: Zor se padho. Jahan atko, wahan line chhoti karo.

steps.title: LOR ke liye pehle poocho
steps.detail: Professor ya manager ko kaafi pehle bolo, aur apna resume aur goals unke saath share karo.

steps.title: Budget sheet banao
steps.detail: Tuition, rent, khaana, travel aur ek emergency buffer. Sab ek sheet mein likho.
steps.tip: Funding ke teen raaste: savings, scholarship, loan.

caption:
Abroad jaana hai? Ye 5 kaam abhi shuru karo 👇

1. Shortlist
2. Test date
3. SOP draft
4. LOR
5. Budget sheet

Save karo 📌 aur us dost ko bhejo jo abhi bhi 'next year dekhenge' bol raha hai.
